# 00000001939

**LG-09 ★** — source: 50_李群离散子群.md

**English.** Definition: A Kac–Moody lattice is a full lattice generated by a generalized Cartan matrix. Conjecture: The minimal covolume of a KM lattice is a closed form in the covering density of the right affine Weyl group (covering density 1/|W_a|·c_n); the covolume formula is verified on all affine-type KM lattices.

**中文。** 定义：Kac–Moody 格指由广义 Cartan 矩阵生成的完全格。猜想：KM 格的最小协体积为右仿射 Weyl 群覆盖密度的闭式(覆盖密度为 1/|W_a|·c_n);协体积公式在一切仿射型 KM 格上验证。
